name: @gjsify/integration-yjs
description: Integration tests: Yjs (the de-facto CRDT for collaborative apps — TipTap, ProseMirror, BlockNote, Hocuspocus). Yjs is pure-JS at its core (no WASM) and exercises a different cross-section of GJS engine surface than Loro: heavy TypedArray / DataView use for the binary wire format, `Map`/`Set`/`WeakMap` for delete-set bookkeeping, structured-clone-style snapshot serialization, and EventEmitter-shaped Observer wiring. Validates `@gjsify/buffer`, `@gjsify/crypto.randomBytes` (Y.Doc clientID generation), `@gjsify/events`, the SpiderMonkey 140 typed-array surface, and `y-protocols/awareness` (the standard Yjs sync companion).

scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs
